faq.q: What is the Klose K17 in GTA 6?
faq.a: A pistol IGN reported as Lucia's chosen sidearm in Grand Theft Auto VI. IGN said it was used often during the Extended Look gameplay reveal and that Ultimate Edition owners can personalize it.

faq.q: Is the Klose K17 the starting pistol in GTA 6?
faq.a: IGN suggested it might be, but called that an expectation rather than a fact. Rockstar has said nothing about which weapon the player begins with, so this site does not record it as the starting pistol.

faq.q: What real gun is the Klose K17 based on?
faq.a: IGN reported it is based on the Glock 17. The comparison is the outlet's reading of the weapon's shape. Grand Theft Auto uses invented manufacturers, and Rockstar has not named any real firearm.

faq.q: Is the Klose K17 Lucia's gun in GTA 6?
faq.a: IGN reported that it is her chosen sidearm. Rockstar has not published a sidearm for either playable character, so treat the pairing as reporting rather than a settled fact.

faq.q: How many rounds does the Klose K17 hold?
faq.a: No magazine size has been published, and neither has damage, price, unlock method or attachment list. Rockstar has released no weapons list for Grand Theft Auto VI at all.
